invalid_ipv4_error: Please enter a valid IPv4 address
auto_assign_ip_notice: System will automatically assign virtual network IP
enable_server_first: Please enable at least one server first
add_server_first: Please add and enable at least one server first
permission_denied_message: Install permission is permanently denied, please go to settings page to enable it manually.
prefer_astral_adapter_desc: Give the AstralNG adapter the highest routing priority on Windows.
launch_at_login_desc: Launch AstralNG automatically after you sign in to this device.
launch_to_tray_desc: Launch in the background without opening the main window. Requires start at sign-in.
connect_after_launch_desc: Connect using the last selected room and enabled server after AstralNG starts.
confirm_delete_listen_item: Are you sure you want to delete listen item "{item}"?
latency_first_desc: Prefer paths with lower measured latency when alternatives are available.
enable_tun_adapter_desc: Create a virtual network adapter so most applications can access the virtual network directly. Keep this enabled in most cases.
socks5_proxy_desc: Provide a SOCKS5 proxy for applications that cannot use the TUN adapter.
socks5_listen_port_desc: Port used by applications that connect to this proxy.
socks5_listen_all_interfaces_desc: Allow other devices to connect through 0.0.0.0. Enable only on trusted networks and restrict access with a firewall.
disable_udp_hole_punching_desc: Do not use UDP hole punching to establish direct peer connections.
disable_tcp_hole_punching_desc: Do not attempt direct peer connections over TCP.
traffic_compression_desc: Choose whether virtual-network traffic is uncompressed or compressed with Zstandard.
physical_interfaces_only_desc: Prevent peer connections from binding to VPNs and other virtual network adapters.
kcp_for_tcp_streams_desc: Convert virtual-network TCP streams to KCP to improve latency and throughput on lossy UDP networks. Falls back to TCP when the peer does not support KCP.
install_permission_not_granted: Install permission not granted, click to request
tray_hide_message:
The tray icon will be removed and you will no longer be able to exit from the tray menu.

You can only end the process from Task Manager. This applies to the current session only; the tray icon returns after restart.

Continue?
compact_peer_cards_desc: Use smaller cards in the Room peer list. Turn off to show traffic statistics and full connection paths.
enable_banner_carousel_desc: Display advertising carousel on home page
update_management_desc: Choose a release channel, configure downloads, and manage available versions.
receive_beta_updates_desc: Choose Stable for everyday use or Beta for prerelease builds that may be unfinished or unstable.
automatic_update_checks_desc: Check in the background and notify when a newer version is available. Updates are not installed automatically.
update_behavior_desc: Choose which releases to receive and when to check for them.
check_update_available: Look for a newer AstralNG release immediately.
previous_versions_desc: Browse and download earlier AstralNG releases.
beta_version_desc: Experience new features early, but may have stability issues
update_download_source_desc: Choose direct GitHub downloads, automatic mirror selection, or a custom mirror.
disable_sym_hole_punching_desc: Skip direct-connection attempts designed for symmetric NAT networks.
permission_description_desc: Install permission is used for automatic app updates
notification_permission_not_granted: Notification permission not granted, tap to request
permission_notification_denied_message: Notification permission is permanently denied. Please enable it manually in system settings.
room_mode_cannot_change: The room mode cannot be changed after creation.
settings_startup_desc: Choose what AstralNG does when you sign in and when it launches.
settings_requires_startup: Enable Start AstralNG at sign-in before using this option.
settings_language_desc: Choose the interface language used throughout AstralNG.
settings_window_behavior_desc: Choose whether the close button hides AstralNG or exits it.
settings_close_to_tray_desc: Keep AstralNG running and available from the system tray.
settings_exit_program_desc: Stop AstralNG and close the application completely.
settings_mobile_general_notice: Your mobile platform manages application startup and window behavior. Connection and notification controls are available in their respective categories.
settings_android_general_notice: Android manages application startup and window behavior. Connection and notification controls are available in their respective categories.
settings_theme_desc: Changes are previewed and saved immediately.
theme_mode_desc: Follow the system theme or always use light or dark mode.
theme_color_desc: Used for selection, connection status, and highlights.
language_desc: Choose the language used by AstralNG.
settings_display_desc: Choose how much detail to show and how often the topology refreshes.
reduce_animation_updates_desc: Refresh the network topology less frequently to reduce GPU usage.
network_changes_next_connection: Network changes are saved now and apply the next time you connect.
connection_behavior_desc: Keep connections working when the network is unstable.
connection_retry_limit_value: Retry up to {count} times after the initial attempt.
auto_connect_managed_general: Configure this in General under Startup.
core_network_desc: Choose the transports and security defaults used for peer connections.
preferred_peer_protocol_desc: Try this transport first when connecting directly to another peer.
encrypt_peer_traffic_desc: Encrypt traffic carried between peers. This adds a small amount of packet overhead.
force_relay_desc: Disable direct peer-to-peer connections and route traffic through relay servers.
network_access_desc: Configure listening addresses, Android VPN routes, and allowed ports.
listen_list_desc: Configure the local protocols and addresses that accept incoming peer connections.
android_vpn_routes_desc: Route additional network ranges through the Android VPN.
allowed_virtual_network_ports_desc: Restrict which TCP and UDP ports can pass through the virtual network.
allowed_ports_format_desc: Allow individual ports such as 80, ranges such as 8000-9000, or a comma-separated combination such as 80,443,8000-9000.
empty_allows_all_ports: Leave empty to allow all ports.
confirm_clear_allowed_ports_desc: All {type} ports will be allowed after this list is cleared.
virtual_network_access_desc: Choose how applications on this device access the virtual network and configure Windows routing priority.
socks5_proxy_with_tun_desc: Usually unnecessary while the TUN adapter is enabled; most applications can already access the virtual network directly.
socks5_port_invalid: Enter a valid port from 1 to 65535.
view_adapter_priorities_desc: Show the routing metric assigned to each Windows network adapter.
advanced_network_warning: These options can reduce connectivity. Change them only when troubleshooting a specific network.
beta_update_checks_required: Beta builds always check for newer beta releases.
redownload_update_desc: Download the selected update again if its files are incomplete or damaged.
stable_channel_desc: You are on the stable channel, recommended for everyday use.
permission_open_system_settings: This permission was denied permanently. Open system settings to grant it manually.
permissions_managed_by_system: This platform does not expose any AstralNG permissions that can be managed from this page.
install_permission_explanation: Allow Android to install an AstralNG update package.
notification_permission_explanation: Allow connection status to appear while AstralNG runs in the background.
connection_notification_desc: Keep the current connection state visible in an ongoing notification.
notification_permission_needed: Grant notification permission before enabling this option.
app_tagline: A calm control plane for your EasyTier network.
support_tools_desc: Collect useful details before troubleshooting a connection.
logs_desc: Review runtime events and connection errors.
copy_diagnostics_desc: Copy the AstralNG version, EasyTier version, and log count for a support request.
no_logs_to_copy: There are no logs to copy.
confirm_clear_logs_desc: This removes every log entry from the current session.
